title: Grace for a New Beginning
opening: God’s mercy invites us to turn back to Him and begin again. A new beginning grows through repentance, grace, and changed daily choices.
points: Receive God’s mercy without making excuses for harmful choices.
Where needed, apologise, make amends, and seek wise guidance.
Build a new pattern through small, faithful actions each day.
reflection: What positive change can you begin with God’s help today?
prayer: Merciful Father, thank You for Your compassion. Help me to turn from what is wrong and walk faithfully in the new beginning You provide. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
